title: HR Business Partner
summary: An HR Business Partner is the main people adviser to a business head, helping them plan headcount, structure teams, grow talent and handle serious employee issues. They sit in the HR team but work day to day with one business unit, drawing on specialists in hiring, pay and learning.
dailyDuties: Meet business leaders to review headcount, hiring and attrition
Prepare people dashboards on attrition and engagement
Run talent review and succession discussions
Guide managers through performance calibration and difficult conversations
Investigate escalated grievances and disciplinary cases
Advise on team structure changes and restructuring
Coordinate with rewards, hiring and learning teams on business needs

skills.expectation: Act as the people adviser to a business head and their leadership team
Build the annual headcount and manpower plan with business and finance
Run talent reviews and keep succession plans for critical roles
Shape team structures and support restructuring decisions
Drive the performance cycle, goal setting and rating calibration
Handle escalated grievances, investigations and disciplinary cases
Track attrition, headcount and engagement data and turn it into actions
Keep people decisions compliant with Indian labour law and POSH
Influence senior leaders and work across HR centres of excellence
Support increment cycles and pay benchmarking with the rewards team
Act on engagement survey results with managers
Use the HRMS for people data and workflows
Present people updates clearly to leaders and employees

certifications.why: Some MNC HRBP posts list SHRM-CP or SCP as a plus.
